_description: Application features and modules discovered from Azure Boards tickets

features.name: Profile Registration
features.description: User registration via email, Facebook, or Apple Sign In. Creates AppUser, validates input, assigns tokens.

features.name: Active Submission Email Auto-Assignment
features.description: Automatically assigns a Shoppix.me email from the pool during registration. No 50-token bonus for auto-assigned emails.

features.name: Service Bus Messaging on Registration
features.description: Sends createuserprofile message and scheduled activesubmissionnotificationtype message after registration.

features.name: Shoppix.me Email Notification at 1pm Next Day
features.description: Schedules ActiveSubmissionRegistrationCompletedEmailNotification to be sent at 1pm the day after registration, respecting DST.

features.name: My Vouchers UI
features.description: Voucher list and voucher detail screens in the rewards module.

features.name: Voucher Listing
features.description: Displays redeemed vouchers as cards with brand, amount, redemption date, and navigation chevron.

features.name: Voucher Detail
features.description: Shows brand-specific voucher information, amount, order reference, email, and redemption date.

features.name: Voucher Redeem CTA
features.description: Shows and routes the Go to my voucher action for supported vouchers.

features.name: Voucher Reference Copy
features.description: Lets the user copy the voucher order reference from the detail screen.

features.name: Notification Messaging Redesign
features.description: Updated notification wording for 26+ notification types with user-centric language, dynamic variables, and redesigned CTA buttons.

features.name: Notification Category Icons
features.description: Category-specific notification icons: shelf, referral, reminder, warning, voucher.

features.name: Notification Deep Links
features.description: Updated and new deep links from notifications to specific app screens.

features.name: Notification Empty State
features.description: Figma-specified empty state with bell illustration and 'Start snapping' CTA.

features.name: Notification Error State
features.description: Figma-specified error state with bell + question mark illustration and 'Try again' CTA.

features.name: Push Notification Configuration
features.description: Updated push notification configuration for delivery settings.

features.name: Account Deactivation
features.description: Allows a logged-in user to deactivate their Shoppix account.

features.name: Account Deletion
features.description: Allows a logged-in user to delete their Shoppix account.

features.name: Facebook Social Login
features.description: Accounts created via Facebook sign-in that may not have a local password.

features.name: Shoppix.me Reward Suppression
features.description: Prevents the legacy 50-token reward from being granted when the Shoppix.me email is assigned during registration.

features.name: Token History
features.description: Screen showing token credits and running balances for the user.

features.name: Reward Notification Suppression
features.description: Ensures no reward-related notification is generated for the removed 50-token incentive.

features.name: Account State Endpoint
features.description: Returns the current lifecycle state of the account and reflects deactivation/deletion.

features.name: Account Deletion Service Bus
features.description: Service bus flow that propagates account deletion to downstream consumers.

features.name: Survey Launch Button Gating
features.description: Controls when the Launch button is enabled for surveys based on survey status.

features.name: Survey Creation Flow
features.description: Adds a survey from the Manage Shoppix survey list using a Tivian survey ID, token value, and expiry date/time.

features.name: Survey Refresh Users
features.description: Refreshes survey users before launch so the survey can be reflected correctly in the app.

features.name: Survey Reflection in App
features.description: Makes the launched survey visible in the Shoppix app after a successful launch.

features.name: Notification Bell Icon
features.description: Notification card layout and states observed from Shoppix app video: read/unread visual states, CTA color mapping, category icons, deep-link targets, timestamps.

features.name: Passive Collection
features.description: Backend + app contract for connecting IMAP mailboxes, scanning receipt emails, capturing user decisions, and submitting raw MIME to the receipt pipeline via outbox.

features.name: Passive Collection - Connect / Reconnect / Validate
features.description: POST /validate, POST /email-accounts, POST /:id/connection-failure endpoints and reconnect UX rules.

features.name: Passive Collection - Scan Ingestion
features.description: POST /:id/scans, GET /:id/scans endpoints. Bulk metadata insert with dedup by EmailUid and forward-only LastScrapedDateTime.

features.name: Passive Collection - Decisions & Raw Content Submission
features.description: PATCH /:id/scans decisions, PUT /:id/scans/{scanId} raw content submission, blob storage layout, and outbox handoff.

features.name: Passive Collection - Multi-device Behaviour
features.description: Adding a mailbox to a second device, resuming pending uploads on a new device, dedup and 409 handling across devices.

features.name: Passive Collection - Account Deletion / Dropout
features.description: DELETE /:id?scope=device|all and useraccountstatusupdated topic subscriber that anonymises accounts, deletes scan logs, and deletes blob container.

features.name: Receipt Transcription Overflow Handling
features.description: transcriptioncomplete queue handling that nullifies over-length string fields and truncates over-precision decimals so receipts persist instead of failing on DB constraints; also removes unused contract fields.

features.name: Waiting List Deeplink Routing
features.description: Waiting-list registration links should open the app flow from the invitation URL.

features.name: Waiting List Invitation Validation
features.description: Invitation GUIDs embedded in deep links must be parsed and validated without accepting malformed tokens.
